kai: Bringing up aurora-7b (Mistral checkpoint converted to Llama layout). After int4 quant, ROUGE-L dropped from 47.8 -> 41.0 on our summarization harness. Anyone seen conversion rotary/casing/vocab quirks cause this?
han: Very likely. Two common culprits: per-head rotary scales collapsed to a global scalar during conversion, or tokenizer sentinel/BOS index off-by-one. Also confirm q/k ordering didn't flip.
kai: Quick repro: 
```
float32 ROUGE-L 47.8
int4 ROUGE-L 41.0
sample: ref="She approved the plan." hyp="She approved plan ."
```
ruth: Run a compact probe: 1) compare headwise attention norm float32 vs int4 (tools/attn_stats.py). 2) dump tokenizer.special_tokens_map + first 20 ids for "the", "plan", punctuation.
han: Converter options to try: `--preserve-per-head-rotary`, `--patch-sentinel-idx`. Also quant scheme: symmetric tends to preserve zero-centering better for these exports.
kai: Kicked reconversion with `--preserve-per-head-rotary --patch-sentinel-idx` and re-quant with `--quant-scheme symmetric`. eval-bot queued job 9001.
eval-bot: queued job 9001 (aurora-7b int4 quick-eval, 150 samples). ETA ~8m.
(8m later)
kai: Results: int4 after fixes ROUGE-L 46.5. Headwise attn variance restored, repeating punctuation gone. Remaining delta ~1.3 likely tokenization normalization differences.
ruth: Great. Followups: add converter unit test that roundtrips per-head rotary scales, add CI smoke that compares 150-sample ROUGE-L delta <= 2.5, and audit quant defaults for Mistral-derived checkpoints.
han: Also add a short checklist in onboarding playbook: check per-head rotary, qkv order, sentinel/BOS index, and quant scheme.
kai: Will open PR with logs, attn plots, and test. Thanks! :seedling:
